result:
As a hypothetical being with the power to change the world in one way, I would choose to eradicate the concept of scarcity. I would make it so that every person on the planet has access to an abundance of resources, including food, water, shelter, healthcare, and education.

In this world, technology would be harnessed to create sustainable and renewable systems that provide for everyone's basic needs. No one would have to worry about where their next meal is coming from, or whether they can afford to see a doctor. Every person would have the opportunity to pursue their passions and interests without being held back by financial constraints.

With scarcity eliminated, I imagine that people would be more likely to focus on personal growth, creativity, and contribution to society. Communities would come together to support one another, and conflicts over resources would cease to exist. The world would be a more collaborative, empathetic, and harmonious place.

Of course, this is a highly idealized vision, and there are many complexities and challenges that would need to be addressed in order to make it a reality. But if I had the power to change the world in one way, this is the direction I would choose.
